title: Drunken neighbourhood brawl in Wayanad leaves one dead, another seriously injured
content: Wayanad: A drunken quarrel between neighbours turned violent, leaving one person dead and another seriously injured at Anappara near Pulpally in Wayanad. The incident took place on Saturday night, and one of the injured died towards noon on Sunday. Laiju, 46, a native of Koodathayi near Thamarassery in Kozhikode district, died while undergoing treatment at the Government Medical College Hospital, Kozhikode, around noon on Sunday. According to the police, Laiju had sustained injuries to his neck and back. The other injured person, Shafeeq Abdul Salam, 35, a native of Thazhava in Kollam district, is undergoing treatment at the Government Medical College Hospital, Mananthavady. The incident occurred around 10 pm on Saturday, when four persons, allegedly under the influence of alcohol, got into a quarrel at their rented accommodation, police said. The quarrel turned violent, and two of them were allegedly attacked with a sharp-edged weapon. Hearing the commotion, local residents rushed to the spot and took the injured Laiju and Shafeeq to the Government Medical College Hospital, Mananthavady. As Laiju's condition deteriorated, he was shifted to the Government Medical College Hospital, Kozhikode, later that night. However, he succumbed to his injuries on Sunday. The Pulpally police have taken two people, Paneer Selvam, 58, and Shekhar, 63, both natives of Nagapattinam in Tamil Nadu, into custody. An interrogation of the accused is underway, and the arrests of both are likely, police said. Police also registered the statements of neighbours, local people and other witnesses. Police are investigating the circumstances leading to the assault. Further details regarding the exact sequence of events and the role of those taken into custody are awaited.
